shortDescription: Manage Auth Roles on a PowerScale Storage System

options.name: access_zone
options.description: Specifies the access zone in which the auth role exists. Access zone once set cannot be changed.

options.name: api_password
options.description: the password of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: copy_role
options.description: Copy the role C(true) will copy the role from the I(role_name).

options.name: description
options.description: Specifies the description of the auth role. Pass empty string to remove the I(description).

options.name: members
options.description: Specifies the members of the auth role.

options.name: new_role_name
options.description: Name of the Auth Role to be used for modify or copy the role.

options.name: onefs_host
options.description: IP address or FQDN of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: port_no
options.description: Port number of the PowerScale cluster.It defaults to 8080 if not specified.

options.name: privileges
options.description: Specifies the privileges granted for this role.

options.name: state
options.description: Defines whether the auth role should exist or not. Value C(present) indicates that the auth role should exist in system. Value C(absent) indicates that the auth role should not exist in system.

options.name: verify_ssl
options.description: boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
